title: Accepted Docara architecture decisions
summary: Decisions that a new task must not silently reverse.

decisions.decision: Keep specification and graph in the Docara repository, not a separate specs repository.
decisions.reason: Code and contract evolve atomically and avoid drift.

decisions.decision: Use one Markdown file per public route.
decisions.reason: Authors edit the real page source directly.

decisions.decision: Use typed internal IR, never hand-authored JSON content.
decisions.reason: Larena-compatible array processing without burdening Docara authors.

decisions.decision: Use a registry plus one Smart gateway.
decisions.reason: Component behavior is extensible without hardcoded page projectors.

decisions.decision: Use one PageBuilder for all build modes.
decisions.reason: Partial build cannot drift from full build.

decisions.decision: Keep system i18n separate from site and article content.
decisions.reason: Any locale can own its complete documentation without engine edits.

decisions.decision: Do not preserve unpublished legacy storage compatibility.
decisions.reason: The product is still under development and simplicity is the priority.

decisions.decision: Migrate through a badge vertical slice before bulk work.
decisions.reason: Proves the whole architecture with bounded risk.

decisions.decision: Do not use the installed stale Docara skill for this migration.
decisions.reason: It documents the retired Jigsaw/Mix architecture.

decisions.decision: One public page in one locale is owned by exactly content/<locale>/<route>.md.
decisions.reason: Route ownership must be physically obvious and collision-safe.

decisions.decision: content/<locale>/lang.json is the only shared public UI translation source; public resources/i18n and site.json compatibility are removed from the target.
decisions.reason: Visible locale strings stay project-owned without creating a second article store.

decisions.decision: CLI and builder localization, if needed, is package-owned and excluded from public page inputs.
decisions.reason: Internal diagnostics must not become site content.

decisions.decision: MarkdownCompiler creates typed Document IR in memory with no mandatory page JSON or JSONL.
decisions.reason: Serialization is useful only for disposable cache, search, diagnostics or test evidence.

decisions.decision: Full and single-page builds use one PageBuilder pipeline and differ only by selected route set.
decisions.reason: Build-mode parity must be architectural, not merely output coincidence.

decisions.decision: Use badge_source_ready before M2 and keep global source_ownership open until M3 completes all route migration.
decisions.reason: A bounded vertical slice must not falsely claim that all 44 generated routes are already Markdown-owned.

decisions.decision: The Docara library repository does not own composer.lock; exact release evidence records the resolved dependency tuple and each consumer project owns its application lock.
decisions.reason: This preserves library dependency ranges while making candidate and consumer reproducibility explicit.
